protocol.ptbxl: 100 Hz; folds 1-8 train, 9 validation, 10 test; five diagnostic superclasses
protocol.mitbih: DS1 train minus validation [106,119,223,230] and record 201; DS2 test; N/S/V/F; context +/-2 beats; two waveform and eight RR channels
protocol.mitbih_patient_correction: 201 and 202 belong to the same subject; remove 201 from training, retain 202 in test. This differs from historical DS1/DS2 results.
protocol.training: All models in a dataset share batch size, optimizer, loss, class weighting, epochs and validation selection. All are trained from scratch.
protocol.mitbih_class_weights: inverse frequency n/(C*count), capped at 8 for every class; no extra S boost, no F-specific cap, no oversampling
protocol.threshold: PTB: report F1 at 0.5 and at one global threshold selected on validation. Test-swept Fmax is labeled oracle/descriptive only. MIT: raw argmax; no class bias.
protocol.statistics: sample SD across five independent training seeds; paired seed differences and Holm-adjusted exact sign-flip tests within dataset/primary-metric families; no claim that seeds are independent patients
protocol.historical_test_exposure: These standard test sets have already been inspected during earlier development. This frozen supplement prevents further adaptive changes but does not erase that exposure or constitute external validation.
protocol.baseline_scope: ECG-Mamba-style reproduction, without Non-Uniform-Mix; no claim of reproducing the full published method.
protocol.efficiency: Parameter counts available immediately. Latency measured only without competing GPU compute processes; otherwise marked deferred.
